case_name: Ms. Neetu Rawat vs State Of Uttarakhand

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Ms. Neetu Rawat, sister-in-law (NANAD) of respondent no.4 Bhawna Rawat
parties.respondent_defendant: State of Uttarakhand, Senior Superintendent of Police District Nainital, Station House Officer Kaladhungi, District Nainital, Smt. Bhawna Rawat

facts_of_case: Petitioner is sister-in-law of respondent no.4, who is pursuing studies in Meerut. First Information Report was registered against petitioner due to matrimonial discord between respondent no.4 and her husband (brother of the petitioner). Petitioner seeks quashing of FIR.

legal_principles.principle: Abuse of process of law is not permitted.
legal_principles.held: It is argued that it is abuse of process of law on the part of the respondent no.4 to implicate the petitioner in the criminal case due to the matrimonial discord between respondent no.4 and her husband (brother of the petitioner).

legal_principles.principle: A First Information Report can be quashed if it is an abuse of process.
legal_principles.held: Urgency Application No. 870 of 2013 is allowed.

outcome.final_order: Petitioner shall not be arrested in connection with F.I.R. No. 04 of 2013 during investigation, provided she cooperates with the investigating agency.
